label: PF Backlog 191
title: Backend: declare required knowledge+skills for ALL agents + advisory coverage + compliance for every agent
body:
## Problem / why
`_load_knowledge_for_agent` reads the SSOT (fixed in BI-0171), but the SSOT only DECLARES knowledge
for 13 agents. 31 of 62 agents declare no knowledge anywhere (caps + card + fallback all empty), so
they load NO role knowledge and `check_agent_compliance` has no role_layers to enforce.

## Goal & value
Every agent declares its required knowledge layers + skills; every agent loads non-empty role
knowledge; compliance runs (and can enforce) for all agents.

## In scope
- Declare `knowledge` + `skills` for the 31 uncovered agents in `config/agent-capabilities.json`
  (mapped to real `docs/guidelines/<layer>` dirs).
- Extend the loader alias map so declared names resolve to real dirs (legal->compliance-legal,
  design->ui-ux).
- Advisory coverage check in `wired_audit`: any agent with no declared knowledge is flagged.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- For all 62 agents, the knowledge loader returns non-empty layers.
- wired_audit advisory: 0 agents without declared knowledge.
- compliance checker has role_layers for every agent that runs.

## Out of scope
- Sourcing NEW guideline content (BI-0172 covers OSS/HF sourcing).

## Verification / test plan
- Script loads knowledge for all 62 agents -> none empty; gate green.

dashboard_impact.reason: Backend capability/knowledge + spec generation; consumed via API, no UI change.

_note: IMPLEMENTED + VERIFIED (not just declared): added knowledge+skills for the 31 uncovered agents in config/agent-capabilities.json (now 44 agent entries) -> all 62 cards covered. Extended the loader alias map in core/orchestrator/agent_runner.py (_ALIAS: legal->compliance-legal, design->ui-ux+rendering, business_logic->business). Added advisory agent_knowledge_audit() to scripts/dev/wired_audit.py (flags any agent whose declared layers resolve to no live guidelines). VERIFIED: wired_audit prints 'agent-knowledge: all agents declare knowledge that resolves to live guidelines'; real GuidelineContentLoader loads 15-20KB per previously-uncovered agent (security-audit/quality_gate/finops/performance/maintenance/static_verifier/strategist/product-analyzer). Compliance for all agents confirmed wired: stage_runner:339 -> execute_agent (compliance step 11) and delegated sub-agents reuse execute_agent (delegation_coord). compileall=0, wired_audit=0. Root cause: BI-0123/0171/0172 were marked complete but never validated all-agent coverage.
